principles: No strategy is promoted from a single aggregate backtest.
2023+ remains sealed for final one-look OOS.
Exact published rules are distinguished from research-inspired proxies.
Blocked families remain in the library until their required data/engine exists; they are never silently approximated as exact.
Adaptive NVIDIA search uses development data only; hidden pre-OOS validation is opened only after the research universe is frozen.
Transaction-cost stress is part of robustness qualification, not a post-hoc sensitivity chart.
Previously falsified or explicitly overfit strategies remain in the registry as terminal negative evidence rather than being silently rediscovered and retested.
